ideas.title: Long-tail generic Search
ideas.audience: Exact and phrase long-tail running queries
ideas.rationale: Generic Running Shoes CPA sits above account average; long-tail terms bid cheaper with higher purchase intent. Last 30 days, Running Shoes: $22,237 spend, CPA $45, ROAS 2.48x.

ideas.title: Brand defense on competitor surge
ideas.audience: Searchers combining your brand with competitor names
ideas.rationale: Competitor Terms CPC nearly doubled in 3 days. Defending brand SERPs costs a fraction of that and protects high-intent clicks. Last 30 days, Competitor Terms: $8,507 spend, CPA $102, ROAS 1.17x.

ideas.title: Feed-only PMax for top SKUs
ideas.audience: Shopping intent, top 50 SKUs by margin
ideas.rationale: Shopping Best Sellers returns the strongest ROAS in the account; isolating those SKUs limits PMax spend leakage. Last 30 days, Best Sellers: $17,230 spend, CPA $23, ROAS 4.26x.

ideas.title: Demand Gen win-back
ideas.audience: Customer Match — no purchase in 90+ days
ideas.rationale: Cart Remarketing converts at 2.2%. Extending to lapsed buyers adds qualified reach ahead of the Q4 peak. Last 30 days, Cart Remarketing: $7,490 spend, CPA $20, ROAS 4.55x.

ideas.title: Shorts creative refresh
ideas.rationale: Q4 Awareness CTR fell by half in 3 days — a creative-fatigue pattern. Vertical Shorts assets reset frequency. Last 30 days, Q4 Awareness: $13,529 spend, CPA $44, ROAS 2.66x.

ideas.title: Holiday gift-guide Shopping
ideas.rationale: Seasonal lift starts in early November; a separate campaign protects Best Sellers budget from dilution. Last 30 days, Best Sellers: $17,230 spend, CPA $23, ROAS 4.26x.

metrics.label: Spend
metrics.description: Total cost of clicks and impressions.

metrics.label: Conversions
metrics.description: Conversions counted by your conversion actions (can be fractional with data-driven attribution).

metrics.label: Avg. CPC
metrics.description: Average cost per click = spend ÷ clicks.

metrics.label: ROAS
metrics.description: Return on ad spend = conversion value ÷ spend.

metrics.label: Search impr. share
metrics.description: Impressions received ÷ impressions you were eligible for (Search & Shopping).

metrics.label: Lost IS (budget)
metrics.description: Share of eligible impressions lost because the budget ran out.

metrics.label: Lost IS (rank)
metrics.description: Share of eligible impressions lost to Ad Rank (bid, quality).

metrics.label: MER
metrics.description: Marketing efficiency ratio = store revenue ÷ total ad spend (blended).
